captions.text: Summer 1940: French India and the South Pacific colonies join.
1940: the king and government go to London.
1940: the country's name is changed to Legionary Romania (the National Legionary State); the page gives no month.
1940: Alsace-Lorraine annexed.
1 February 1940: the Attachment Scheme begins with Pethapur and adds territory to Baroda until 1943.
1940, 31 March: "The Karelo-Finnish Soviet Socialist Republic was established by the Soviet government on 31 March 1940 by merging the" Karelian ASSR with the Finnish Democratic Republic.
30 March 1940: 'On 30 March 1940, the RNG was established in Nanjing.'

1940, 12 March: the Moscow Peace Treaty cedes the Karelian Isthmus with Viipuri and the Ladoga shore to the Soviet Union; the Karelo-Finnish page puts the ceded lands in the republic ("created in territory ceded by Finland in the Winter War").
24 March 1940: Mengjiang is incorporated into the Reorganized National Government (Wang Jingwei regime).

30 March 1940: 'merged into Wang Jingwei's Nanjing-based reorganized national government on 30 March 1940'; it 'stayed virtually independent' as the North China Political Council 'until the end of the war'.

30 March 1940: 'merged into Wang Jingwei's Nanjing-based Reorganized National Government on 30 March 1940'; the Reorganized National Government page: 'The RNG absorbed the Reformed Government (1938-1940) and the Provisional Government (1937-1940)'.

30 March 1940: 'The RNG absorbed the Reformed Government (1938-1940) and the Provisional Government (1937-1940)'; the former Provisional Government territory 'retained semi-autonomous status as the North China Political Council'; Shandong and Hebei were 'de jure part of this political entity' but 'under Japanese military administration'.

24 March 1940: 'In 1940 an agreement was signed between the Inner Mongolian puppet state of Mengjiang and the RNG, incorporating the former into the latter as an autonomous part' (RNG page); the Mengjiang page gives the date 24 March 1940.
1940, 13 March: the Winter War ends with the Moscow Peace Treaty (the Finland page: signed 12 March, 'the war ended the following day'; the Winter War page: 13 March 1940).
1940, March: Finland cedes the Karelian Isthmus with Vyborg and Ladoga Karelia.

1940, March: Finland also cedes Salla, the Rybachy Peninsula and islands in the Gulf of Finland to the Soviet Union (the page's list: 'Cession of the Gulf of Finland islands, Karelian Isthmus, Ladoga Karelia, Salla, Rybachy Peninsula').
1940, March: Hanko is leased to the Soviet Union.
1940, 31 March: the Karelian ASSR becomes the Karelo-Finnish SSR, a union republic.
1940, March: the Winter War ends.
1940, March: Finland cedes Karelia to the Soviet Union.
9 April 1940: with Denmark occupied by Germany, Greenland governs itself.
9 April 1940: Greenland's tie to occupied Denmark is cut.

9 April 1940: 'On 9 April 1940, Germany invaded Denmark in Operation Weserubung'; the King 'remained in the country as Danish head of state' and 'the government remained functioning de jure until the end of the war'.
9 April 1940: Germany invades Norway (Operation Weserübung); the occupation 'began on 9 April 1940'.
1940: Denmark occupied.
1940: Germany invades Norway on 9 April 1940 (German-occupied Europe table; Nazi Germany page: the invasion 'began on 9 April').
1940: Germany invades and occupies Belgium.
1940: Germany annexes Eupen-Malmedy again.
1940, 10 May: Britain occupies Iceland.
10 May 1940: the Wehrmacht invades.
1940: the Netherlands occupied from 10 May 1940 under the Reichskommissariat Niederlande; no annexation (table gives the end as 20 May 1945).
1940: Belgium occupied from 10 May 1940; parts annexed (Gau Cologne-Aachen, Reichsgau Wallonien, Reichsgau Flandern).
1940: Luxembourg occupied on 10 May 1940 (annexed as Gau Moselland, see 1942).
1940: the attack in the west begins on 10 May 1940 against France and the Low Countries ('Occupied 10 May 1940'; the Nazi Germany page: Hitler ordered the attack in May 1940).
1940: Eupen-Malmedy annexed.
1940: Germany invades and occupies the Netherlands.
10 May 1940: British forces invade Iceland.
18 June 1940: de Gaulle's appeal at the BBC founds Free France.

1940, 16 June: the Soviet Union occupies Estonia after the ultimatum of 16 June ('On 16 June 1940 the Soviets issued an ultimatum'); the Estonia page has the Red Army in 'the next day', 17 June, and dates a blockade to 14 June.
14 June 1940: Spain occupies Tangier.
15 June 1940: the Soviet Union invades Lithuania.
10 June 1940: 'Conventional armed resistance to the German invasion ended on 10 June 1940'; the Norwegian 6th Division surrendered in Northern Norway that day.
28 June 1940: the Soviet Union occupies Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina.
1940: Norway 'was fully occupied by early June'.

June 1940: the German occupation of the mainland is complete; Reichskommissar Josef Terboven took over power by forming his own cabinet on 20 September 1940 and Quisling was 're-instituted as head of state on 20 February 1942' of a 'pro-German puppet government'.
1940: Norway under the Reichskommissariat Norwegen with a Norway National Government as puppet; occupied until 8 May 1945, never annexed.
1940: France 'surrendered on 22 June'.
June 1940: Germany occupies the north and west.
1940: the northern and Atlantic zone of France is occupied (table: 'Occupied 10 May 1940'); Vichy France is the French State.
1940: Guernsey.
1940: ultimatums on 16 June, Soviet troops enter Latvia on 17 June 1940 and a pro-Soviet government is installed on 20 June.
1940: Spain occupies Tangier on 14 June.
1940, 28 June: after Molotov's ultimatums of 26 and 27 June Romania accepts and the Red Army enters Bessarabia, Northern Bukovina and the Hertsa region.
1940, 28 June to 4 July: the Soviet Union takes Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina from Romania.

1940, 21 July: the Estonian SSR is "nominally established to replace the until then independent Republic of Estonia on 21 July 1940" after the Red Army occupation of 16-21 June; "formally annexed into the Soviet Union on 6 August 1940".
1940, 21 July: infobox "SSR established: 21 July 1940" after the Soviet occupation of 17 June 1940; "On 5 August, the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union completed the annexation process".
1940, 21 July: "the new People's Seimas declared that the Lithuanian people desired to join the Soviet Union" after the Red Army occupation of 16 June 1940; "On 3 August, a Lithuanian delegation ...
10 July 1940: the Vichy regime begins.
10 July 1940: the Republic ends; the occupation continues under the successors (nazi-germany and vichy-france dossiers).
1940: the first French cells.

10 July 1940: the Republic's mandate over Syria and Lebanon passes to Vichy France; the mandate itself ran until 1946 (Mandate page: 'The French mandate lasted until 1946, when French troops finally left Syria and Lebanon').
10 July 1940: the Indochinese protectorates pass to Vichy France (the dossier ends here; the protectorate itself continues under Vichy France, which the french-indochina dossier carries).
1941: northern Vietnam is occupied.
10 July 1940: the Third Republic ends.
July 1940: the Italian offensive on the Sudanese border begins.
July 1940: Moyale.
21 July 1940: the occupation becomes annexation.

21 July 1940: Lithuania's People's Seimas asks to join the Soviet Union, ending the Republic of Lithuania; the Supreme Soviet accepted 'in early August' (the Soviet dossier dates the incorporation 3 August).
1940: Jersey.
July 1940: the north and the Atlantic coast are German-occupied.
June 1940 to September 1943: 'a sliver of French territory in the Alps was under direct Italian administration'.
July 1940: the zone occupied by Germany stays French land under the Vichy government.
July 1940: the north and the Atlantic coast are German-occupied while remaining part of the French State.

1940, 2 August: "The republic was formed on 2 August 1940 from parts of Bessarabia and parts of the Moldavian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic"; Bessarabia was "annexed from Romania on 28 June of that year".
August 1940: Italy takes British Somaliland.
1940, 6 August: 'Estonia was annexed by the Soviet Union as the Estonian SSR.'
1940, 6 August: the occupation ends in annexation (the infobox gives the end of the occupation period as 6 August 1940).
1940, 6 August: the republic ends in law and in fact; the West did not recognise the annexation and the government in exile 'was the government recognized by the Western world during the Cold War'.
26 August 1940: Chad rallies.
27 August 1940: Cameroon rallies.
29 August 1940: the Middle Congo rallies.
30 August 1940: Ubangi-Shari rallies.
August 1940: French Cameroon rallies to the Free French.
August 1940: Chad, Middle Congo and Ubangi-Shari rally to the Free French.
30 August 1940: the Second Vienna Award gives Hungary Northern Transylvania.
1940: Italy annexes British Somaliland.
30 August 1940: the Second Vienna Award gives Hungary Northern Transylvania.
1940, 2 August: the Moldavian SSR "was established that day from six Bessarabian counties plus the westernmost part of the MASSR, about 4,118 km2", "effectively dissolving it".
1940, 2 August: page silent on the rest of the territory; the infobox lists Moldova and Ukraine as the land today, so the rest is drawn as returning to the Ukrainian SSR.

1940, 2 August: the Moldavian SSR is formed from six Bessarabian counties and the westernmost part of the autonomous republic, "effectively dissolving it". [Reviewer eu-17-x: mirror of the Ukrainian SSR dossier's vassal_end.]
1940, 2 August: "the Supreme Soviet unanimously approved the dissolution of the old Moldavian ASSR".
1940, 2 August: the westernmost part of the Moldavian ASSR, "about 4,118 km2", joins the six Bessarabian counties.
2 August 1940: the Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic is established on the main part of the annexed Bessarabia.
1940: occupation ends in annexation: on 5 August 1940 the USSR grants the rigged Saeima's petition of 21 July and Latvia becomes 'the 15th Soviet republic'.

1940: the Soviet Union incorporates Latvia on 5 August 1940 as the Latvian SSR; the Latvian government, the ECHR, the US and the EU hold the occupation and incorporation illegal (1996 parliamentary declaration: 'a military occupation and an illegal incorporation'); Russia says it was legal.
1940, 2 August: the autonomous republic is dissolved; its westernmost 4,118 km2 go to the Moldavian SSR, and the page is silent on the rest.
1940, 2 August: the occupation ends as the territory is allotted: the Moldavian SSR "was established on the main part of the annexed territory".
1940, 2 August: the Ukrainian SSR receives Northern Bukovina, the Hertsa region, larger parts of Hotin and the Ismail and Cetatea Alba counties (Budjak).

1940, 2 August: the Moldavian SSR is formed from six Bessarabian counties and the westernmost part of the autonomous republic (about 4,118 km2), "effectively dissolving it"; the page is silent on the rest of the territory, which the infobox lists as Moldova and Ukraine today, so it is drawn as returning to the Ukrainian SSR.
2 August 1940: Northern Bukovina, Hertsa and the Budjak counties are allotted to the Ukrainian SSR.
1940, 3 August: Lithuania is incorporated into the Soviet Union.
1940, 5 August: Latvia is incorporated into the Soviet Union.
1940, 6 August: Estonia is incorporated into the Soviet Union (see Lithuania and Latvia for the June ultimata).
1940: Japan enters northern Indochina.
13-18 September 1940: the Italian invasion of Egypt.
7 September 1940: Romania cedes Southern Dobruja to Bulgaria by the Treaty of Craiova.
1940: the Treaty of Craiova gives Southern Dobruja back to Bulgaria.
1940: Cliopatria's row ends here, not the Greek state.
27 October 1940: the Free French attack Vichy Gabon.
1940: Phibun invades French Indochina.
12 November 1940: Gabon falls to Free France, completing the equatorial colonies.
12 November 1940: the Battle of Gabon ends.
11 December 1940: 'the Italians were defeated at Sidi Barrani', the first battle of Operation Compass; the page does not date the last Italian post on Egyptian soil.
December 1940: Operation Compass.
November 1940: the Free French attack Vichy Gabon.
12 November 1940: Gabon falls to the Free French.
12 November 1940: Gabon passes to the Free French.
1940 (November): Free France moves on Vichy Gabon.
1940 (12 November): Vichy Gabon falls.
British Africa without the Asian lands and the Union of South Africa
the 1939 outline for 1940, under Soviet occupation from June
the Cliopatria 1940 shape without Gabon and with Chad: Chad, Cameroon, the Congo and Ubangi-Shari as they stood at the end of August 1940; Gabon is added on 12 November
Cliopatria's 1940 shape without Chad: Free French from August 1940; Gabon joins them on 12 November 1940
122,164 km2: the state before the Second Vienna Award of 30 August 1940, which added Northern Transylvania (43,104 km2); that gain is in the ledger with its month and the 1941 shape holds it.
3.51 M km2: the 1939 shape plus British Somaliland (877 cells, about 222,000 km2) occupied in August 1940; the page's infobox dates the annexation to 19 August 1940.
the Karelo-Finnish SSR of 1940-1944: the Karelian ASSR, Ladoga Karelia and the Karelian Isthmus with Vyborg
643,832 km2, 173 km2 below the neighbouring shapes (113 vertices against 118); the cell grid is identical.
the corrected 1939 shape, Soviet-occupied from 15 June 1940
245,867 km2 is the state after the Soviet occupation of 28 June-3 July 1940 (301,073 - 50,762 = 250,311) and before the 30 August Vienna Award (-43,104) and the 7 September Craiova cession (-7,142).
346,050 km2 for 1940-1941: the Moscow Peace Treaty border ('Finland ceded 9% of its territory': Gulf of Finland islands, Karelian Isthmus, Ladoga Karelia, Salla, Rybachy Peninsula).

Russia proper from 31 March 1940: without the Karelian ASSR, Ladoga Karelia and the Karelian Isthmus (the Karelo-Finnish SSR), Kaliningrad, Tuva, the Kurils and southern Sakhalin; without Petsamo (Finnish until 1944)
with Northern Bukovina, Hotin and Budjak (August 1940)
the 1940 shape without Xinjiang and Tuva and with the lakes filled in
1941: Ethiopia is liberated from Italian rule and the Ethiopian state is restored.
Spring 1941: Kosovo joins Albania under Italian auspices.
1941: Italian Somaliland occupied.
1941: Moyale returns to the British.
1941: Ethiopia under British military administration (infobox).
1941: most of Ethiopia is under British military occupation after the liberation.
1941: the Ogaden stays under British military administration.
Kharan separates: 'Kharan became a separate princely state between the 1931 and 1941 censuses' (the Agency page lists Kharan State and Las Bela State with Kalat as princely states in 1941).
April-May 1941: the Yugoslav partition.
after 1940: 'The port of Shanghai and the cities of Hankou and Wuchang were also placed under control of the Reformed Government after 1940.'
1941: Hanko is back in Finnish hands.
1941: Montenegro passes to Italy.
1941: Italy annexes land on the Adriatic.
1941: Kosovo passes to Italian-ruled Albania.
1941: the Kingdom of Greece is drawn from 1 January 1941, the year after Cliopatria's First Hellenic Republic row ends (1940), so that the Greek state does not vanish from the map.
1941: Thailand attacks Laos and Cambodia.
18 January 1941: the Italians leave Kassala.
February 1941: Operation Compass takes Cyrenaica.
1941: British forces occupy Italian Somaliland.
1941: Eritrea falls.
30 April 1941: Georgios Tsolakoglou is appointed prime minister of the occupation government in Athens.
10 April 1941: the Independent State of Croatia is proclaimed at Zagreb.
18 April 1941: Italy occupies Montenegro.
22 April 1941: German Military Commander takes charge of occupied Serbia.
1941: British Somaliland recovered.
9 April 1941: Greenland becomes a protected state of the United States.
April 1941: Hungary joins the invasion of Yugoslavia (begun 6 April; capitulation 17 April) and annexes the north.
March-April 1941: the Axis counter-offensive retakes Cyrenaica.
8 April 1941: British forces recapture British Somaliland.
1941: Eritrea falls.
1941: Addis Ababa falls on 6 April.
April 1941: the United States takes Greenland under its protection Cliopatria draws 8,186 cells (2.1 M km2) of Greenland as plain US land from 1941 to 1945.
April 1941: Hungary occupies and annexes the north-east.
6 April 1941: the Axis invades Yugoslavia.
10 April 1941: the Independent State of Croatia is proclaimed.
17 April 1941: Yugoslavia capitulates.
1941: Montenegro under Italian rule.
1941: the Italian zone in Greece.
April 1941: the Germans hold Athens, Thessaloniki and Macedonia.
April 1941: the Italians hold most of the Greek mainland south and west.
10 April 1941: the NDH is a German client from its birth.
18 April 1941: Italian military government of Montenegro begins.
1941: Yugoslavia invaded 6 April 1941; the Serbian Military Administration ran 30 April 1941 to January 1945 under a Commissioner Government.

1941: 'Northern Yugoslavia was annexed in April 1941' (Nazi Germany page); Reichsgau Karnten and Steiermark (German-occupied Europe table); the Territorial evolution page names Lower Styria without a date.

1941: 'It was established in parts of occupied Yugoslavia on 10 April 1941' and was 'a puppet state of Nazi Germany from 1941 to 1945' (also a protectorate of Fascist Italy 1941-1943 and, from 18 May 1941 to September 1943, 'a territorial condominium of Germany and Italy').
1941: Greece occupied from 6 April 1941 under a Military Administration with the Hellenic State as puppet; no annexation.
1941: Bulgaria occupies Greek Thrace and Eastern Macedonia.
1941: Bulgaria occupies Yugoslav Macedonia and Pirot.
22 April 1941: Germany rules Serbia directly.
19 April 1941: Bulgaria enters Macedonia and eastern Serbia.
April 1941: Serbia passes to German military rule.
April 1941: Germany takes northern Slovenia.
May 1941: Britain defeats the Iraqi rising and occupies Iraq again.
1941: the Tokyo treaty cedes the Cambodian provinces to Thailand.
1941: the Tokyo treaty cedes two Lao provinces to Thailand.
1941: the war ends in Japanese-dictated cession.
14 May 1941: Bulgaria annexes eastern Macedonia and Western Thrace.
18 May 1941: the Treaties of Rome give Italy the Dalmatian coast and islands.
1941: Italian protectorate over the NDH.
May 1941: Britain defeats the Iraqi rising and occupies Iraq.
1941: the Franco-Thai War ends.
1941: France cedes Laotian and Cambodian territory to Thailand.
22 June 1941: the first Partisan uprising, in the Brezovica woods between Sisak and Zagreb.
8 June 1941: the Syria-Lebanon campaign begins.
8 June 1941: British, Commonwealth and Free French forces invade the Vichy-held mandate.
1 June 1941: Crete falls to Germany.
22 June 1941: Romania joins the German attack on the Soviet Union.
1941, 22 June: "Nazi Germany invaded the USSR and occupied all of Lithuania within a month."
1941: Operation Barbarossa 'began just before dawn on 22 June 1941'.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariats Ostland and Ukraine.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariats Ostland and Ukraine.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: Moldova inside Cliopatria's 1942 shape.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union from 22 June 1941 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union from 22 June 1941 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.

1941, June: "Immediately after the start of German-Soviet War in June 1941" the Germans enter; "On 29 June 1941 OUN members launched an uprising in Lviv" and the next day "after the entry of German troops" Stetsko proclaimed the Ukrainian state; "By 10 July 1941, German forces found themselves on distant approaches to Kyiv"; Lviv, Drohobych, Stanislaviv and Ternopil oblasts are incorporated into t
1941, 22 June: Germany invades the Soviet Union.
25 July 1941: German civil administration of the Reichskommissariat Ostland begins.
1941: "Estonia was occupied by Nazi Germany in 1941" and "administered as a part of Reichskommissariat Ostland" (infobox: German occupation 1941-1944).

14 July 1941: the Vichy forces give in. 'At one minute past midnight on 12 July, a ceasefire came into effect'; the Convention of Acre was signed on 14 July; 'Syria and Lebanon taken over by Free France'.
1941: Japan occupies southern Indochina.
14 July 1941: Vichy forces yield by the Armistice of Saint Jean d'Acre.
July 1941: Syria and Lebanon pass under Free France.
July 1941: the mandate passes from Vichy France to Free France.
12 July 1941: independence is declared and a restored Kingdom of Montenegro is proclaimed under an Italian regent.
1941, 7 July: the United States takes over Iceland's defence from Britain: the defence was 'transferred from Britain' on 7 July 1941 after the US agreement of 16 June.
26 July 1941: Bessarabia, Northern Bukovina and Hertsa are back in Axis hands.
July 1941: Romania retakes Bessarabia, Northern Bukovina and Hertsa.
1941, 1 July: "German troops occupied Riga on 1 July 1941" (infobox: Nazi occupation 1941-1945).
25 July 1941: Germany governs the Reichskommissariat.
23 July 1941: Peru invades the coast.
1941, 19 July: Finland occupies East Karelia.
1941: Peru invades Ecuador's coast.
1941, 16 July: "Their next target was Smolensk, which fell on 16 July" (the Eastern Front began on 22 June 1941 with Operation Barbarossa).
28 July 1941: the Partisans enter Užice and found the Republic of Užice.

1941, 26 July: Romanian and German troops complete the occupation of Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina; Izmail and Chernivtsi oblasts are attached to Romania, Odesa and the surrounding area becomes the Transnistria Governorate (UkrSSR page; the page gives no day).
1941, July: Germany occupies the Baltic states.
1941, July: Belarus and the Smolensk road fall.
1941, July: Romania retakes Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina.
7 July 1941: the United States takes over Iceland's defence.
1941, 7-8 July: American forces replace the British.
7 July 1941: the United States takes over the protection of Iceland, 'by agreement with Iceland'.
20 August 1941: Hitler establishes the Reichskommissariat Ukraine.
1 August 1941: the District of Galicia is added after Operation Barbarossa.
19 August 1941: the Transnistria Governorate is established under Romanian administration (Odessa fell on 16 October 1941).
4 August 1941: the state is renamed again.
1941: Bezirk Bialystok.
25 August 1941: the Soviet Union invades northern Iran.
25 August 1941: British and Indian forces invade the south.
31 August 1941: the fighting ends.
31 August 1941: the fighting ends in the south (stand-down 29 August, ceasefire 30 August).
25 August 1941: Britain and the Soviet Union invade Iran.
August 1941: Peru holds the southern mountains.
1941: Peru holds Ecuador's southern mountains.
29 August 1941: Serbia gets a puppet government.
1941, 25 August: British and Soviet forces invade Iran.
1941, August: Finland retakes the Karelian Isthmus and Ladoga Karelia in the Continuation War.
September 1941: the Soviets hold the north.
September 1941: the British hold the south, 'south of Hamadan and Qazvin'.
1 September 1941: German civil administration begins.
1941, September: Finland regains the Karelian Isthmus and Ladoga Karelia.
1941, September: most of Ukraine is lost.
17 November 1941: the Main National Liberation Committee for Serbia is founded in Užice, seat of the short-lived republic of the liberated west.
3 October 1941: the occupied territory is retitled the Governorate of Montenegro.
1941, October: Operation Typhoon takes "Oryol (captured 5 October)"; the page does not date Bryansk, Kursk or Belgorod, which fell in the same advance (October 1941 is an upper bound for them).

1941, autumn: the German and Romanian forces "took control of all of the peninsula by autumn" while Sevastopol "held out until 3 July 1942" (Eastern Front page; the year 1941 is implied by the section, not written in the sentence); the Crimean offensive page says only that the Germans took control of the peninsula "after the Crimean Campaign in 1942".
1941, by October: "By October, the Germans had captured Kharkiv and Stalino."
1941: the last Italian stand in East Africa ends at Gondar.
1941: the Crimea.
By 29 November 1941: German forces suppress the uprising and the republic of Užice, the first liberated territory in Europe, falls.
1941: Hong Kong falls.
1941: Guam is seized.
1941: Guam and Wake are seized.
24 December 1941: Saint-Pierre and Miquelon.
1941: Japan occupies the Gilbert Islands: Japan 'occupied the Gilbert Islands on 9-10 December 1941', 'three days after the attack on Pearl Harbor'.
24 December 1941: the capital leaves Manila.
December 1941: Operation Crusader.
1941: Japan invades Sarawak.
1941: 6 December, the German attack on Moscow is suspended and the Soviet counteroffensive begins (furthest advance 27 November, Khimki within 30 km of the Kremlin).
1941, summer: "Belarus was occupied by Nazi Germany"; much of the territory becomes the General District Belarus within Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: Finland "occupied most of the Karelian lands that had been within the USSR before 1940, including the capital Petrozavodsk".
1941: the seat moves to Belomorsk (infobox "Petrozavodsk Belomorsk (1941-1944)").

1941: "In the summer of 1941, Romania joined Hitler's Axis in the invasion of the Soviet Union", "recovering Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina, and also occupying the territory to the east of the Dniester".
5 December 1941: Estonia is added.
December 1941: 'During the December 1941 Japanese offensive the Reorganized Government extended its control over Hunan, Hubei, and parts of Jiangxi provinces.'
1941: Penang falls to Japan.
December 1941: the Japanese occupy Brunei.
1 December 1941: the Germans reconquer the Republic of Užice.
10 December 1941: Japan takes Guam.
23 December 1941: Japan takes Wake.
British Africa without the Asian lands and the occupied Italian East Africa and the Union of South Africa
1941-1942: the 1940 outline without the provinces ceded to Thailand under the Tokyo peace treaty of 9 May 1941; Hanoi stays French (Japanese-occupied)
the four districts plus District Galicia, added on 1 August 1941
174,011 km2 against the infobox's 172,149 km2 (1941): ratio 1.01.

Montenegro without 'the Bay of Kotor', annexed 'as part of the Italian Governorate of Dalmatia', and without Plav and Gusinje ('a significant amount of the Andrijevica district including Plav and Gusinje') and 'the town of Ulcinj', lost to Albania; the page adds 'some villages around Tutin and Rožaj

the shape unchanged, but Montenegro, the Greek zone and the French zone are occupations (hatched), Albania a protectorate, and only Dalmatia, Ljubljana Province, Kotor and Kosovo are annexed (status change only)
the Reich of 1940 plus northern Slovenia and the Bialystok region; the Balkan lands are occupation; Libya removed (Italian territory throughout the North African campaign page)

Cliopatria's 1941 outline (Southern Dobruja kept; plus all of Greek Thrace and most of Macedonia and 'Macedonia with Pirot' after Yugoslavia and Greece were defeated) unchanged, with everything beyond the 1940 frontier as occupied land, hatched
Lithuania, Latvia and Belarus at the start of German civil administration on 25 July 1941 (Estonia was added on 5 December 1941)
the Reorganized National Government 1941-1945: its 1940 land and the Wuhan cities, less the unoccupied south-west corner of Shanxi that Yan Xishan held

the Cliopatria shape of 1941 without Tibet's land, which the Republic claimed but did not govern: 'Since 1912, Tibet had been de facto independent of Chinese control'; with Xinjiang, which stayed Chinese under Soviet tutelage

captions.text: 1942: Japan occupies Burma.
1942: Japan occupies Hong Kong, Malaya and Borneo.
1942: Australia adopts the Statute of Westminster.
1942: the Dutch East Indies.
1942: the Italian zone in Greece widens (Greece 30 to 206 cells in Cliopatria's shape); the page does not date the extension.
1942: the occupation becomes annexation.
1942: Germany annexes Luxembourg (page silent on the date; August 1942 in the nazi-germany dossier).
1942: Japan rules the Pakualaman.
1942: Japan occupies Pontianak.
1942: Peru leaves Loja and Zamora Chinchipe.
1942: after the Second Enemy Offensive (January to early February) the Partisan headquarters moves to Foča.
31 January 1942: the second Anglo-Ethiopian Agreement.
1942: Japan takes North Borneo.

1942: the Japanese invade the Solomon Islands (January 1942): 'after the Japanese invasion of the Solomon Islands in January 1942'; the Guadalcanal campaign page: they 'had occupied Tulagi in May 1942'.
1942: Japan invades the Territory of New Guinea.
January 1942: Japan invades the Indies.
1942: Rabaul falls, 23 January.
1942: Japan invades the Solomon Islands in January 1942 ('Japan invaded the Solomon Islands in January 1942').
31 January 1942: the second Anglo-Ethiopian Agreement ends British military occupation in most of Ethiopia.
2 January 1942: Manila falls to Japan.
January 1942: Operation Theseus.
1942: Labuan is occupied by Japan 'from 3 January 1942 until June 1945'.
1942: Malacca falls to Japan on 15 January 1942.
Italian Somaliland stays under British military administration.
Eritrea stays under British military administration.
February 1942: Japanese forces land on Sumatra (month only) and, on 19 February, on Timor after taking Ambon; the Eastern Task Force.
1942: Malaya, Borneo and Singapore.
1942: Japan invades Timor.

1942: Japan invades Portuguese Timor; the page says a British, Australian and Dutch force had occupied it in December 1941 'to preempt a Japanese invasion' and that 'the Japanese did invade in the Battle of Timor in February 1942'.
15 February 1942: Japan occupies the federation.
February 1942: Japan invades.
12 February 1942: Peru leaves El Oro.
1942: Peru leaves El Oro.
1942: Peru leaves Loja and Zamora Chinchipe.
1942: Singapore falls on 15 February 1942, the last settlement to fall.
1943: the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are under Japanese occupation.
9 March 1942: the Dutch surrender Java and the Indies fall.
1942: Burma.
1942: Japan occupies the Andaman Islands.
1942: the Philippines.
May 1942: the rest of the archipelago is Japanese-held.
1942: the Thai Phayap Army takes the Shan States.
May 1942: Japan occupies the Philippines.
1942: Japan lands on Attu.
1942: Japan lands on Kiska (6 June 1942), the day before Attu; see the Attu event.
June 1942: Gazala and Tobruk.
1942: Case Blue launched 28 June; German troops reach the Volga at Stalingrad 23 August; Operation Uranus encircles the 6th Army 19-23 November.
